full_prompt_en: A square black-and-white documentary photograph places a helmeted man close to the camera in the right foreground of a dark, crowded vehicle interior. His face occupies much of the right half, and the broad worn helmet crosses the upper center with scuffs and seams visible on its surface. He looks slightly upward and outward with steady eyes, a tense closed mouth, and dirt or rough texture across his cheeks. The chin and neck fall into deeper shadow, while straps and folds of practical clothing descend to the lower edge. Behind his left shoulder, two other helmeted figures sit farther back in the dim space. One near the middle turns in profile; another sits even farther left, largely softened by shadow and the shallow depth of field. A bright vertical opening at the far left admits pale daylight, creating a strong contrast with the nearly black enclosure. Above the group, a small piece of mechanical equipment or a circular fixture is visible near the top center, adding to the cramped interior without defining the whole vehicle. Dark structural edges, seats, and overlapping bodies fill the lower and upper corners, leaving little empty space. The foreground man's face is sharply resolved compared with the rear figures, making the eye move from his direct expression to the quieter group behind. The image carries visible grain and slightly rough tonal transitions, especially in the black recesses and gray fabric. Side light from the opening reaches the helmet and face, lifting the eyes and cheekbones while the surrounding interior stays deep and uneven. The overall composition feels close, pressured, and observational, with bright facial detail emerging from a dense field of helmets, equipment, and shadow.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形黑白纪实摄影把一位戴头盔的男子放在昏暗拥挤车厢的右侧近前景，距离相机很近。他的面孔占据右半部大部分，宽大而磨旧的头盔横过上方中央，表面可见擦痕和接缝。他目光略向上、向外，眼神稳定，嘴巴紧闭而带紧张感，脸颊有灰尘或粗糙肌理。下巴和颈部落入更深阴影，实用衣物的带子与褶皱一直延至下边缘。左肩后，两位戴头盔的人坐在昏暗处更远的位置。靠近中央的一位转成侧面；更左侧的另一位受阴影和浅景深影响而更柔。在最左侧，一道明亮竖向开口引入浅色日光，与近黑的围合空间形成强烈反差。人群上方、顶部中央附近可见一小件机械设备或圆形装置，增加空间的局促感，却不完全定义车辆。深色结构边缘、座位和互叠身体填满上下角落，几乎没有空白。近前男子的面孔比后方人群解析得更清楚，使目光从他直接的神情移向身后更安静的群组。图像带可见颗粒和略粗糙的色调过渡，特别是在黑色凹处与灰衣上。来自开口的侧光落到头盔与面孔，托起眼睛和颧骨，周围车厢仍深沉且明暗不均。整体构图贴近、压迫而重观察，让发亮的面部细节从头盔、设备与阴影的密集色域中浮出。
style_prompt_en: Black-and-white documentary photography uses close framing, strong side light, and layered human-scale depth. A sharply resolved foreground plane rises from deep charcoal, while surrounding forms retreat through grain, soft focus, and heavy shadow. Pale highlights are concentrated on a few surfaces and small openings; most of the composition stays in textured mid-gray and black. Overlapping dark shapes compress the frame and convey physical closeness without decorative staging. Edges are practical and irregular, with scuffs, folds, and surface wear left visible. Light enters laterally, revealing selected contours and letting the rest of the space remain uncertain. The overall visual effect is immediate, tense, and observant, with tonal grit and depth more important than polished symmetry.
style_prompt_zh: 黑白纪实摄影采用贴近取景、强侧光和层叠的人的尺度纵深。清楚解析的前景平面从深炭色中浮起，周围形体则通过颗粒、柔焦与浓影退远。浅色亮部集中在少数表面与小开口上，构图大部留在有肌理的中灰和黑色里。互叠深色形体压缩画幅，传达身体上的贴近，而不靠装饰性布景。边缘实在且不规则，擦痕、褶皱和表面磨损都被留下。光从侧面进入，显出选定轮廓，让其余空间仍有不确定性。整体视觉效果即时、紧张而重观察，色调粗粝与纵深比光洁对称更重要。
theme_en: A helmeted man looking outward from a dark crowded vehicle interior
theme_zh: 一名戴头盔的男子从拥挤昏暗的车厢内向外望去
name: Larry Burrows
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
